meta.licenseNote: SAM 3.1 (Meta, 2026-03-27) ships under the SAM License: research and commercial use allowed with no thresholds; military, nuclear, espionage and weapons uses banned; the licence travels with any redistribution; Meta may change the terms. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: The `sam3.1/segment` graph prompted with points instead of text: SAM3_Detect's positive_coords and negative_coords take JSON lists of pixel coordinates in the request's own pixels (the engine scales the canvas points to the request size; '[]' when there are none, which the node accepts, checked live 2026-10-16); no conditioning, so the detector segments whatever object the positive points land on and keeps clear of the negative ones (individual_masks true, 2 refinement passes). The prompt placeholder is bound but unused (the backend requires one).
meta.creator: Meta
meta.description: Finds the object under a click, clear of the spots marked to exclude
